createTime.description_en: The time when the data transformation job was created
createTime.title: 创建时间

lastModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the data transformation job was last modified
lastModifiedTime.title: 最近一次修改时间

status.description_en:
The status of the data transformation job. Valid values:

RUNNING
STOPPING
STOPPED
SUCCEEDED
FAILED
STARTING
RESTARTING
status.description_zh:
加工状态，表示返回加工任务的状态，取值包括：
RUNNING：运行中
STOPPING: 停止中
STOPPED: 已停止
SUCCEEDED: 运行成功
FAILED: 运行失败
STARTING：启动中
RESTARTING：重启中
status.title: 加工状态

accessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID that is required to read data from the source Logstore. This parameter is required. If you use a RAM role for authorization, set this parameter to an empty string
accessKeyId.description_zh: 授权读取源Logstore的AccessKey ID，必填。使用角色授权时，填入空字符串
accessKeyId.title: 授权读取源Logstore的AccessKey ID，必填。使用角色授权时，填入空字符串

accessKeySecret.description_en: The AccessKey secret that is required to read data from the source Logstore. This parameter is required. If you use a RAM role for authorization, set this parameter to an empty string
accessKeySecret.description_zh: 授权读取源Logstore的AccessKey Secret，必填。使用角色授权时，填入空字符串
accessKeySecret.title: 授权读取源Logstore的AccessKey Secret，必填。使用角色授权时，填入空字符串。

fromTime.description_en: The start time of the data transformation. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. This parameter is required. To start the data transformation from the earliest log in the source Logstore, set this parameter to 0
fromTime.description_zh: 加工时间起点时间戳（精确到秒），必填。从源Logstore中最早接收到的第一条日志开始消费时，填入0
fromTime.title: 加工时间起点时间戳（精确到秒），必填。从源Logstore中最早接收到的第一条日志开始消费时，填入0

logstore.description_en: The name of the source Logstore
logstore.title: 源Logstore名称

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role that is authorized to read data from the source Logstore
roleArn.title: 授权读取源Logstore的角色ARN

sinks.description_en: The output destinations of the data transformation
sinks.description_zh: 加工结果输出目标列表
sinks.title: 加工结果输出目标列表

toTime.description_en: The end time of the data transformation. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. This parameter is required. To continuously perform the data transformation until you manually stop it, set this parameter to 0
toTime.description_zh: 加工时间结束时间戳（精确到秒），必填。持续消费至手动停止时，填入0
toTime.title: 加工时间结束时间戳（精确到秒），必填。持续消费至手动停止时，填入0

accessKeyId.title: 授权写入目标Logstore的AccessKey ID

accessKeySecret.title: 授权写入目标Logstore的AccessKey Secret
